reference: Olkiluoto, Finland, crystalline bedrock (no published log for these boxes)

description.lithology: Gneiss / migmatitic gneiss - light to medium grey and whitish-grey, medium-grained, foliated to banded gneissose fabric with irregular leucocratic quartz-feldspar segregations and darker biotite-rich bands, texture massive to weakly banded in the photographed interval, both rows (top and bottom) show the same lithology with no sharp lithological contact visible.
description.alteration: none visible - no distinct chloritic, sericitic, silicified, potassic, carbonate or oxidised alteration discernible at this photo resolution; grey-white colour appears primary gneissic composition rather than alteration.
description.mineralization: none visible - no sulfides or ore minerals (pyrite, chalcopyrite, pyrrhotite, sphalerite, galena) visible as disseminations, veinlets, blebs or massive accumulations, estimated 0 vol%.
